You can call the function on multiple inputs at a time by running PYTHON(./temp0/function.py string1 string2 string3 ...).

[DESCRIPTION]: Describe what the function is doing in language.

Based on the outputs generated by the function, it appears that the function implements a simple transformation on the input strings. It takes each input string and reverses it, appending the reversed string with the original string.

[DESCRIPTION]: The function reverses each input string and concatenates it with the original string.

[CODE]: A Python approximation of the behavior of the function could be as follows:

```python

  return x[::-1] + x
```
